title: Neat concept. Works and will be great for anyone without ears or dogs
text:
Neat concept. Works and will be great for anyone without ears or dogs. This thing is hard to get going at first. Soaked the wick for hours and then had to turn it on and off a few times to get it started. Every time I turn it off, I can go to turn it right back on and I still have to turn it off and on a few times to start it. Now it DOES work and has a decent output. My only issue is that it has a high pitched shrill sound that is like a knife to my ears. I've never heard anything ultrasonic do this before either! And my dogs started going crazy. My huge dog climbed into my lap whining and it took me a while to calm him down once I unplugged it. I swear I still hear that high pitched sound too, it's terrible sounding!

This was a neat idea with poor execution.
